BlockForest.reason: R / Rscript not installed in this environment; rpy2 not installable without R. blockForest is an R-only package (Hornung & Wright 2019). Documented honestly per task spec instead of silently skipped.
BlockForest.to_run: install R + blockForest R package, install rpy2, wrap blockForest::blockfor() with cv.error.frac=0.5 + classification=FALSE for survival, OOB risk score per patient, then re-run paired bootstrap.

method_notes: RSF (sksurv RandomSurvivalForest; n_estimators=300, min_samples_split=10, max_features='sqrt'). EVAL = LOO N=787 (matched to v12 Cox protocol exactly): one full RSF refit per held-out patient. Full-cohort OOB score reported as a sanity-check diagnostic ('oob_score_full_cohort_diagnostic') and matches LOO C-index within 0.01 in both variants. Paired bootstrap stratified by cyto stratum, B=10000. NOTE: an earlier version of this script reported in-sample (training-set) C-index by calling rsf.predict on the same data the model was fit on; that produced overfit C ~0.93 and is corrected by the LOO protocol used here.
